docs.summary: A running bake: created by [`Start`](#api~Prowl.Photonic.LightmapBaker~Start), driven via [`Poll`](#api~Prowl.Photonic.Job~Poll) / [`Wait`](#api~Prowl.Photonic.Job~Wait), terminated via [`Cancel`](#api~Prowl.Photonic.Job~Cancel).

Number of completed sample-accumulation passes in continuous mode. Increments after each iteration; the caller can watch it (e.g. once per render frame) and re-upload the atlas when it changes. Always 0 outside of continuous mode.

docs.summary: Set which texel's rays the integrator should record each iteration. Pass `null` for `target` (or coordinates outside the target) to disable recording.
Returns a snapshot of the segments produced by the most recent recorded path for the debug texel.

members.name: GetTexelInfo
members.signature: public TexelDiagnostic GetTexelInfo(LightmapTarget target, int x, int y)

docs.summary: Read back the integrator's recorded data for one texel of the given target. Returns [`Valid`](#api~Prowl.Photonic.TexelDiagnostic~Valid) = false until the rasterise phase has completed, or if the target wasn't part of this bake.
Free-text description of what the bake is doing right now (texel rasterisation, integration, etc.).

Fires after the worker thread finishes folding a full iteration into the atlas. Argument is the iteration count just completed. The callback runs on the worker thread; don't touch UI state directly from it without marshalling.
Returns true while the job is still running.
Block until the job ends. If the bake threw, the inner exception is rethrown here (rather than wrapped in `AggregateException`).
Block until `iterations` additional accumulator iterations have completed (or the bake is cancelled / fails). Useful for headless / scripted bakes: `baker.Start().RunIterations(64); baker.Cancel();`.
Request cancellation. The job ends as soon as the worker reaches its next cancel-check.
